title: Add wait_for_tasks so a conductor can block on results
done_when: Shipped. wait_for_tasks blocks until the named task ids reach a terminal status or the timeout fires, returning the same rendering get_task_result would (src-tauri/src/mcp.rs). Bounded: 600s default, 1800s ceiling. A timeout is worded distinctly from completion and cancels nothing. Ids are validated for existence and ownership before any blocking. Halt outranks the wait. Polls via tasks_from, which reconciles pane liveness, so a dead pane's task becomes abandoned and releases the wait rather than holding it to the ceiling. 9 tests. Design salvaged from feat/wait-and-nudge (fb1f041); that branch's idle-pane nudge was deliberately left for task q0h7c4.
